name: Exp_ColorStochNR
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorStochNR custom stochastic indicator, offering five distinct entry algorithms including level breakthrough, oscillator direction change, signal line twist, oscillator crossing signal line, and signal line crossing the 50 level. It opens and closes positions on new bars using the selected algorithm and delegates trade execution to an included TradeAlgorithms library for position sizing and order management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorStochNR自定义随机指标进行交易，提供五种不同的入场算法：50水平突破、振荡器方向改变、信号线转向、振荡器穿越信号线和信号线穿越50水平。它在出现新K线时根据所选算法开仓和平仓，并将交易执行委托给内置的TradeAlgorithms库进行仓位管理和订单处理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorStochNR随机指标的动量信号进行交易。入场条件提供五种模式：Breakdown模式在随机指标突破50水平时入场；OscTwist模式在振荡器方向改变时入场；SignalTwist模式在信号线方向改变时入场；OscDisposition模式在振荡器穿越信号线时入场；SignalBreakdown模式在信号线穿越50水平时入场。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms库统一处理，包含偏差控制以防止滑点过大。策略在每根新K线上检测信号，避免逐tick交易，降低交易频率。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy trades momentum signals from the ColorStochNR stochastic indicator. Entry conditions offer five modes: Breakdown mode enters when the stochastic breaks the 50 level; OscTwist enters on oscillator direction change; SignalTwist enters on signal line direction change; OscDisposition enters when the oscillator crosses the signal line; SignalBreakdown enters when the signal line crosses the 50 level. Exit conditions rely on fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, plus reverse signal-triggered position closes. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot size and positive values calculate lots as a deposit share. Money management is handled uniformly by the TradeAlgorithms library, which includes deviation control to prevent excessive slippage. The strategy detects signals only on new bars, avoiding per-tick trading and reducing trade frequency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供五种入场算法模式，策略灵活度高，适应不同市场环境
基于新K线检测信号，避免逐tick重复交易，降低交易成本
有止损止盈设置和偏差控制，具备基本风险管理框架
买卖权限独立控制，可灵活调整单向或双向交易
使用iCustom获取指标句柄，指标与EA解耦，便于替换指标
pros_en: Five distinct entry algorithm modes provide high strategy flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
New bar-based signal detection avoids per-tick redundant trading and reduces transaction costs
StopLoss, TakeProfit, and deviation controls provide a basic risk management framework
Buy and sell permissions are independently controllable, allowing flexible unidirectional or bidirectional trading
Uses iCustom for indicator handle retrieval, decoupling the indicator from the EA for easy replacement
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库和ColorStochNR自定义指标，缺少这些文件则无法编译运行
OscDisposition模式中Signal[0]的判断逻辑有冗余，如'Signal[0]==2 || Signal[0]'在Signal[0]非零时恒真
OscTwist模式的条件判断复杂且可读性差，容易出现逻辑错误
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时可能以不利价格入场
没有追踪止损或动态止盈机制，固定止损止盈无法适应市场波动变化
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library and ColorStochNR custom indicator; without these files it cannot compile or run
OscDisposition mode has redundant logic such as 'Signal[0]==2 || Signal[0]' which is always true when Signal[0] is non-zero
OscTwist mode conditions are complex and hard to read, prone to logical errors
No spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices during wide spread conditions
No trailing stop or dynamic take-profit mechanism; fixed SL/TP cannot adapt to changing market volatility
improvements: 添加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免不利滑点
优化OscDisposition和OscTwist模式的条件判断逻辑，提高代码可读性和正确性
增加追踪止损功能，让盈利仓位在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause new entries when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable slippage
Refine the condition logic in OscDisposition and OscTwist modes to improve code readability and correctness
Add a trailing stop feature to let winning positions lock in more profit as trends continue

risk_points: 依赖外部库和自定义指标，缺失任一文件将导致EA无法运行
OscDisposition模式中冗余条件可能导致非预期开仓信号
固定止损止盈在高波动市场中可能频繁触发止损或错失利润
risk_points_en: Depends on external library and custom indicator; missing any file causes EA failure
Redundant conditions in OscDisposition mode may generate unexpected entry signals
Fixed SL/TP may trigger stops frequently or miss profits in high volatility markets
